cs/sun_salutation_voice_cobra.transcript: Nadechněte se a zvedněte hrudník do kobry.

cs/sun_salutation_voice_downward_dog.transcript: Vydechněte a zvedněte boky nahoru a dozadu.

cs/sun_salutation_voice_intro_1.transcript: Postavte se na přední okraj podložky. Chodidla u sebe.

cs/sun_salutation_voice_knees_chest_chin.transcript: Vydechněte a položte kolena, hrudník a bradu.

cs/sun_salutation_voice_lunge_left.transcript: Nadechněte se, levou nohu dejte dozadu a koleno na zem.

cs/sun_salutation_voice_lunge_right.transcript: Nadechněte se, pravou nohu dejte dozadu a koleno na zem.

cs/sun_salutation_voice_mountain_end.transcript: Vydechněte a vraťte se do pozice hory.

cs/sun_salutation_voice_mountain_start.transcript: Stůjte vzpřímeně v pozici hory a vydechněte.

cs/sun_salutation_voice_plank.transcript: Vydechněte a ustupte nohama dozadu do prkna.

cs/sun_salutation_voice_plank_hold.transcript: Nadechněte se a vydržte. Tělo v přímce.

cs/sun_salutation_voice_rise.transcript: Nadechněte se a vzpřimte se. Paže nad hlavou.

cs/sun_salutation_voice_salute.transcript: Nadechněte se a zvedněte paže nad hlavu.

cs/sun_salutation_voice_step_forward_lef.transcript: Nadechněte se a levou nohu přeneste mezi dlaně.

cs/sun_salutation_voice_step_forward_rig.transcript: Nadechněte se a pravou nohu přeneste mezi dlaně.

de/sun_salutation_voice_closing.transcript: Ruh dich aus und spüre deinen Atem.

de/sun_salutation_voice_cobra.transcript: Atme ein und hebe die Brust in die Kobra.

de/sun_salutation_voice_downward_dog.transcript: Atme aus und schiebe die Hüften nach oben und hinten.

de/sun_salutation_voice_fold.transcript: Atme aus und beuge dich nach vorn.

de/sun_salutation_voice_intro_1.transcript: Stell dich vorne auf deine Matte, die Füße zusammen.

de/sun_salutation_voice_intro_2.transcript: Lass die Arme locker neben dem Körper.

de/sun_salutation_voice_knees_chest_chin.transcript: Atme aus und senke Knie, Brust und Kinn.

de/sun_salutation_voice_lunge_left.transcript: Atme ein und stell das linke Bein zurück. Das Knie am Boden.

de/sun_salutation_voice_lunge_right.transcript: Atme ein und stell das rechte Bein zurück, das Knie am Boden.

de/sun_salutation_voice_mountain_end.transcript: Atme aus und komm zurück in die Berghaltung.

de/sun_salutation_voice_mountain_start.transcript: Steh aufrecht in der Berghaltung und atme aus.

de/sun_salutation_voice_plank.transcript: Atme aus und tritt zurück in die Planke.

de/sun_salutation_voice_plank_hold.transcript: Atme ein und halte. Der Körper gerade.

de/sun_salutation_voice_rise.transcript: Atme ein und richte dich auf, die Arme über den Kopf.

de/sun_salutation_voice_salute.transcript: Atme ein und führe die Arme über den Kopf.

de/sun_salutation_voice_step_forward_lef.transcript: Atme ein und setz den linken Fuß zwischen die Hände.

de/sun_salutation_voice_step_forward_rig.transcript: Atme ein und setz den rechten Fuß zwischen die Hände.

en/sun_salutation_voice_closing.transcript: Rest here and notice your breath.

en/sun_salutation_voice_cobra.transcript: Breathe in and lift your chest into cobra.

en/sun_salutation_voice_downward_dog.transcript: Breathe out and lift your hips up and back.

en/sun_salutation_voice_intro_1.transcript: Stand at the front of your mat, feet together.

en/sun_salutation_voice_intro_2.transcript: Let your arms rest by your sides.

en/sun_salutation_voice_knees_chest_chin.transcript: Breathe out and lower knees, chest, and chin.

en/sun_salutation_voice_lunge_left.transcript: Breathe in and step your left leg back, knee down.

en/sun_salutation_voice_lunge_right.transcript: Breathe in and step your right leg back. Knee down.

en/sun_salutation_voice_mountain_end.transcript: Breathe out and return to mountain pose.

en/sun_salutation_voice_mountain_start.transcript: Stand tall in mountain pose and breathe out.

en/sun_salutation_voice_plank.transcript: Breathe out and step back into plank.

en/sun_salutation_voice_plank_hold.transcript: Breathe in and hold. Body straight.

en/sun_salutation_voice_rise.transcript: Breathe in and rise, arms overhead.

en/sun_salutation_voice_salute.transcript: Breathe in and sweep your arms overhead.

en/sun_salutation_voice_step_forward_lef.transcript: Breathe in and step your left foot between your hands.

en/sun_salutation_voice_step_forward_rig.transcript: Breathe in and step your right foot between your hands.

es/sun_salutation_voice_closing.transcript: Descansa aquí y observa tu respiración.

es/sun_salutation_voice_cobra.transcript: Inhala y eleva el pecho a la cobra.

es/sun_salutation_voice_downward_dog.transcript: Exhala y lleva la cadera arriba y atrás.

es/sun_salutation_voice_fold.transcript: Exhala y flexiona el tronco hacia adelante.

es/sun_salutation_voice_intro_1.transcript: Ponte de pie al frente de la esterilla, pies juntos.

es/sun_salutation_voice_intro_2.transcript: Deja los brazos relajados a los lados.

es/sun_salutation_voice_knees_chest_chin.transcript: Exhala y baja rodillas, pecho y barbilla.

es/sun_salutation_voice_lunge_left.transcript: Inhala y lleva la pierna izquierda atrás, rodilla al suelo.

es/sun_salutation_voice_lunge_right.transcript: Inhala y lleva la pierna derecha atrás. Rodilla al suelo.

es/sun_salutation_voice_mountain_end.transcript: Exhala y vuelve a la postura de la montaña.

es/sun_salutation_voice_mountain_start.transcript: De pie, en la postura de la montaña. Exhala.

es/sun_salutation_voice_plank.transcript: Exhala y lleva los pies atrás a la plancha.

es/sun_salutation_voice_plank_hold.transcript: Inhala y mantén el cuerpo recto.

es/sun_salutation_voice_rise.transcript: Inhala y sube, con los brazos por encima de la cabeza.

es/sun_salutation_voice_salute.transcript: Inhala y lleva los brazos por encima de la cabeza.

es/sun_salutation_voice_step_forward_lef.transcript: Inhala y lleva el pie izquierdo entre las manos.

es/sun_salutation_voice_step_forward_rig.transcript: Inhala y lleva el pie derecho entre las manos.

fr/sun_salutation_voice_cobra.transcript: Inspirez et soulevez la poitrine en cobra.

fr/sun_salutation_voice_downward_dog.transcript: Expirez et poussez les hanches vers le haut et l'arrière.

fr/sun_salutation_voice_intro_1.transcript: Placez-vous à l'avant du tapis, pieds joints.

fr/sun_salutation_voice_intro_2.transcript: Laissez les bras reposer le long du corps.

fr/sun_salutation_voice_knees_chest_chin.transcript: Expirez et posez genoux, poitrine et menton.

fr/sun_salutation_voice_lunge_left.transcript: Inspirez et reculez la jambe gauche, genou au sol.

fr/sun_salutation_voice_lunge_right.transcript: Inspirez et reculez la jambe droite, genou au sol.

fr/sun_salutation_voice_mountain_end.transcript: Expirez et revenez dans la posture de la montagne.

fr/sun_salutation_voice_mountain_start.transcript: Debout, dans la posture de la montagne, expirez.

fr/sun_salutation_voice_plank.transcript: Expirez et reculez les pieds en planche.

fr/sun_salutation_voice_plank_hold.transcript: Inspirez et tenez, le corps aligné.

fr/sun_salutation_voice_rise.transcript: Inspirez et redressez-vous, les bras au-dessus de la tête.

fr/sun_salutation_voice_salute.transcript: Inspirez et levez les bras au-dessus de la tête.

fr/sun_salutation_voice_step_forward_lef.transcript: Inspirez et avancez le pied gauche entre les mains.

fr/sun_salutation_voice_step_forward_rig.transcript: Inspirez et avancez le pied droit entre les mains.

id/sun_salutation_voice_cobra.transcript: Tarik napas dan angkat dada ke pose kobra.

id/sun_salutation_voice_downward_dog.transcript: Buang napas dan dorong pinggul ke atas dan ke belakang.

id/sun_salutation_voice_fold.transcript: Buang napas dan bungkukkan badan ke depan.

id/sun_salutation_voice_intro_1.transcript: Berdiri di depan matras, kedua kaki rapat.

id/sun_salutation_voice_intro_2.transcript: Biarkan lengan rileks di samping tubuh.

id/sun_salutation_voice_knees_chest_chin.transcript: Buang napas dan turunkan lutut, dada, dan dagu.

id/sun_salutation_voice_lunge_left.transcript: Tarik napas dan langkahkan kaki kiri ke belakang, lutut turun.

id/sun_salutation_voice_lunge_right.transcript: Tarik napas dan langkahkan kaki kanan ke belakang. Lutut turun.

id/sun_salutation_voice_mountain_end.transcript: Buang napas dan kembali ke pose gunung.

id/sun_salutation_voice_mountain_start.transcript: Berdiri tegak dalam pose gunung dan buang napas.

id/sun_salutation_voice_plank.transcript: Buang napas dan langkahkan kaki ke belakang ke posisi plank.

id/sun_salutation_voice_plank_hold.transcript: Tarik napas dan tahan. Badan lurus.

id/sun_salutation_voice_rise.transcript: Tarik napas dan berdiri, lengan di atas kepala.

id/sun_salutation_voice_salute.transcript: Tarik napas dan angkat lengan ke atas kepala.

id/sun_salutation_voice_step_forward_lef.transcript: Tarik napas dan langkahkan kaki kiri di antara tangan.

id/sun_salutation_voice_step_forward_rig.transcript: Tarik napas dan langkahkan kaki kanan di antara tangan.

it/sun_salutation_voice_closing.transcript: Riposa e ascolta il tuo respiro.

it/sun_salutation_voice_cobra.transcript: Inspira e solleva il petto nel cobra.

it/sun_salutation_voice_downward_dog.transcript: Espira e spingi i fianchi in alto e indietro.

it/sun_salutation_voice_intro_1.transcript: In piedi, davanti al tappetino, piedi uniti.

it/sun_salutation_voice_intro_2.transcript: Lascia le braccia rilassate lungo i fianchi.

it/sun_salutation_voice_knees_chest_chin.transcript: espira e abbassa ginocchia, petto e mento.

it/sun_salutation_voice_lunge_left.transcript: Inspira e porta la gamba sinistra indietro, ginocchio a terra.

it/sun_salutation_voice_lunge_right.transcript: Inspira e porta la gamba destra indietro, ginocchio a terra.

it/sun_salutation_voice_mountain_end.transcript: Espira e torna nella posizione della montagna.

it/sun_salutation_voice_mountain_start.transcript: In piedi nella posizione della montagna, espira.

it/sun_salutation_voice_plank.transcript: Espira e porta i piedi indietro in plank.

it/sun_salutation_voice_plank_hold.transcript: Inspira e resta, il corpo dritto.

it/sun_salutation_voice_rise.transcript: Inspira e sali, le braccia sopra la testa.

it/sun_salutation_voice_salute.transcript: Inspira e porta le braccia sopra la testa.

it/sun_salutation_voice_step_forward_lef.transcript: Inspira e porta il piede sinistro tra le mani.

it/sun_salutation_voice_step_forward_rig.transcript: Inspira e porta il piede destro tra le mani.

ja/sun_salutation_voice_closing.transcript: ここで休み、呼吸を感じて

ja/sun_salutation_voice_fold.transcript: 息を吐いて前に体を倒して

ja/sun_salutation_voice_intro_1.transcript: マットの前に立ち、両足を揃えて

ja/sun_salutation_voice_intro_2.transcript: 腕は体の横で楽にして

ja/sun_salutation_voice_intro_3.transcript: 鼻からゆっくり呼吸して

ja/sun_salutation_voice_knees_chest_chin.transcript: 息を吐いて膝、胸、あごを床へ

ja/sun_salutation_voice_plank_hold.transcript: 息を吸って 体をまっすぐ保って

ja/sun_salutation_voice_salute.transcript: 息を吸って両腕を頭上へ

ja/sun_salutation_voice_step_forward_rig.transcript: 息を吸って右足を両手の間へ

ko/sun_salutation_voice_downward_dog.transcript: 숨을 내쉬며 엉덩이를 위로 뒤로 보내세요

ko/sun_salutation_voice_intro_1.transcript: 매트 앞쪽에 서서 두 발을 모으세요.

ko/sun_salutation_voice_knees_chest_chin.transcript: 숨을 내쉬며 무릎 가슴 턱을 내리세요

ko/sun_salutation_voice_lunge_left.transcript: 숨을 들이쉬며 왼쪽 다리를 뒤로 무릎을 내리세요

ko/sun_salutation_voice_lunge_right.transcript: 숨을 들이쉬며 오른쪽 다리를 뒤로 무릎을 내리세요.

ko/sun_salutation_voice_mountain_start.transcript: 산 자세로 곧게 서서 숨을 내쉬세요

pt/sun_salutation_voice_cobra.transcript: Inspire e eleve o peito na cobra.

pt/sun_salutation_voice_downward_dog.transcript: Expire e leve o quadril para cima e para trás.

pt/sun_salutation_voice_fold.transcript: Expire e incline-se para a frente.

pt/sun_salutation_voice_intro_1.transcript: Fique em pé na frente do tapete, pés juntos.

pt/sun_salutation_voice_intro_2.transcript: Deixe os braços relaxados ao lado do corpo.

pt/sun_salutation_voice_knees_chest_chin.transcript: Expire e desça joelhos, peito e queixo.

pt/sun_salutation_voice_lunge_left.transcript: Inspire e leve a perna esquerda para trás, joelho no chão.

pt/sun_salutation_voice_lunge_right.transcript: Inspire e leve a perna direita para trás. Joelho no chão.

pt/sun_salutation_voice_mountain_end.transcript: Expire e volte à postura da montanha.

pt/sun_salutation_voice_mountain_start.transcript: Fique em pé na postura da montanha e expire.

pt/sun_salutation_voice_plank.transcript: Expire e leve os pés para trás, em prancha.

pt/sun_salutation_voice_plank_hold.transcript: Inspire e sustente, com o corpo reto.

pt/sun_salutation_voice_rise.transcript: Inspire e suba, com os braços acima da cabeça.

pt/sun_salutation_voice_salute.transcript: Inspire e eleve os braços acima da cabeça.

pt/sun_salutation_voice_step_forward_lef.transcript: Inspire e leve o pé esquerdo entre as mãos.

pt/sun_salutation_voice_step_forward_rig.transcript: Inspire e leve o pé direito entre as mãos.

ru/sun_salutation_voice_cobra.transcript: Вдохните и поднимите грудь в позу кобры.

ru/sun_salutation_voice_downward_dog.transcript: Выдохните и поднимите таз вверх и назад.

ru/sun_salutation_voice_intro_1.transcript: Встаньте у переднего края коврика. Стопы вместе.

ru/sun_salutation_voice_knees_chest_chin.transcript: Выдохните и опустите колени, грудь и подбородок.

ru/sun_salutation_voice_lunge_left.transcript: Вдохните и отведите левую ногу назад. Колено на пол.

ru/sun_salutation_voice_lunge_right.transcript: Вдохните и отведите правую ногу назад, колено на пол.

ru/sun_salutation_voice_mountain_end.transcript: Выдохните и вернитесь в позу горы.

ru/sun_salutation_voice_mountain_start.transcript: Встаньте прямо, в позе горы и выдохните.

ru/sun_salutation_voice_plank.transcript: Выдохните и шагните назад в планку.

ru/sun_salutation_voice_plank_hold.transcript: Вдохните и задержитесь. Тело в одну линию.

ru/sun_salutation_voice_rise.transcript: Вдохните и поднимитесь, руки над головой.

ru/sun_salutation_voice_salute.transcript: Вдохните и поднимите руки над головой.

ru/sun_salutation_voice_step_forward_lef.transcript: Вдохните и поставьте левую стопу между ладонями.

ru/sun_salutation_voice_step_forward_rig.transcript: Вдохните и поставьте правую стопу между ладонями.

zh/sun_salutation_voice_closing.transcript: 在这里休息，感受你的呼吸。

zh/sun_salutation_voice_cobra.transcript: 吸气，胸部上抬，成眼镜蛇式

zh/sun_salutation_voice_intro_1.transcript: 站在垫子前端，双脚并拢

zh/sun_salutation_voice_intro_2.transcript: 双臂自然垂放在身体两侧

zh/sun_salutation_voice_knees_chest_chin.transcript: 呼气膝盖胸部和下巴落地

zh/sun_salutation_voice_lunge_left.transcript: 吸气，左腿向后迈，膝盖落地。

zh/sun_salutation_voice_lunge_right.transcript: 吸气 右腿向后迈 膝盖落地

zh/sun_salutation_voice_plank.transcript: 呼气 双脚后退成平板式

zh/sun_salutation_voice_rise.transcript: 吸气，起身体，双臂举过头顶

zh/sun_salutation_voice_step_forward_rig.transcript: 吸气右脚向前迈到双手之间
